title: Yellow Citrusy Korean Tortillas Wrap
description: A vegetarian-friendly Korean-inspired dish featuring citrusy and creamy flavors wrapped in tortillas, perfect for a light lunch or snack. This dish combines the freshness of citrus with the comfort of creamy sauce and crunchy vegetables.

ingredients.name: yellow citrus sauce
ingredients.notes: made with lemon juice, garlic, and ginger

ingredients.name: creamy slaw
ingredients.notes: made with shredded cabbage, mayonnaise, and rice vinegar

ingredients.name: pickled carrots
ingredients.notes: sliced carrots pickled in vinegar and sugar

ingredients.name: cucumber kimchi
ingredients.notes: made with sliced cucumbers, Korean chili flakes, and fish-free sauce

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the yellow citrus sauce ingredients and set aside.
In a separate bowl, mix together the creamy slaw ingredients and refrigerate until ready to use.
Slice the pickled carrots and cucumber kimchi into thin strips.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spreading a layer of creamy slaw on each tortilla, followed by a few strips of pickled carrots and cucumber kimchi.
Drizzle the yellow citrus sauce over the top of each wrap.
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds and chopped green onions over the top of each wrap.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2 days.
